title: Stats Modifier
features: This script has a speed, big head, WIP sword feature, and more! Enjoy ;)
script:
---------------------------
-- TOOLS TAB
---------------------------
local ToolsTab = Window:CreateTab("Tools", 4483362458)
local ToolsSection = ToolsTab:CreateSection("Give Tools")

ToolsTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Give Sword",
    Callback = function()
        local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local sword = Instance.new("Tool")
        sword.Name = "c00l Sword"
        sword.RequiresHandle = true
        local handle = Instance.new("Part")
        handle.Size = Vector3.new(1,4,1)
        handle.Name = "Handle"
        handle.Parent = sword
        sword.Parent = plr.Backpack
    end,
})

ToolsTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Delete All Tools",
    Callback = function()
        local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        for _,tool in ipairs(plr.Backpack:GetChildren()) do
            tool:Destroy()
        end
    end,
})

-- New button: Give gear by asset ID
ToolsTab:CreateButton({
    Name = "Give Gear (ID: 18651377368)",
    Callback = function()
        local plr = game.Players.LocalPlayer
        local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")
        local success, gear = pcall(function()
            return InsertService:LoadAsset(18651377368)
        end)

        if success and gear then
            local tool = gear:GetChildren()[1]
            if tool:IsA("Tool") then
                tool.Parent = plr.Backpack
            end
        else
            warn("Failed to load gear with ID 18651377368")
        end
    end,
})
